content:
[Intro]
@voice bm_george
(break 2)

[Verse 1 - the phrase]
@voice af_heart
(slot auto)
I used to chop each word like it was kindling,
A little dip in every single syllable,
The line kept dwindling,
Thin and brittle.
A second, that's the middle of a phrase,
One breath to carry all it has to say,
Then pause.
Two small gaps to a bar, that's all it takes,
A quarter of the time is empty space.
The quiet isn't lazy, it's the frame,
No shame.
So run the words together, let them ride on the same air.

[Hook]
@voice bm_george
Take it in and let the line run long,
(run long!)
Leave a gap and let the beat come through,
Don't chop the word, just carry on,
(carry on!)
Say it once and let it move.
One breath, one phrase, room in the song,
One breath, one phrase, room in the song.
(break 2)

[Verse 2 - the chopper]
@voice am_michael
(slot 2)
I'm stutter, I'm the chopper,
Each word, a full stopper,
Gaps in every corner,
No phrase is getting longer.
Half a second, falter,
Half a second, falter,
A sentence cut to pieces,
The meaning never reaches.
The voice dips, then it rises,
The meter thinks it's silence,
A hundred tiny pauses,
And no one knows the causes.
That's choppy, hear it dropping,
It's stopping, starting, stopping,
The level's off, it's simple,
Dips become a signal.

[Hook]
@voice bm_george
(slot auto)
Take it in and let the line run long,
(run long!)
Leave a gap and let the beat come through,
Don't chop the word, just carry on,
(carry on!)
Say it once and let it move.
One breath, one phrase, room in the song,
One breath, one phrase, room in the song.
(break 2)

[Verse 3 - the fix]
@voice af_heart
So squeeze the loud parts gently, lift the quiet,
A flatter level, try it, don't deny it,
Hold it steady.
Then join the lines that want to go together,
Long phrase, short phrase, the pause is like a feather.
From half a second up to one whole second,
Well reckoned.
Same voice, same words, same tempo, same old beat below,
The only thing I changed in here was where the breathing goes.
A phrase that lasts will always beat a splinter,
No hurry.
It waits, it fills the lungs, and then delivers.

[Bridge]
@voice bm_george
It's easy on the ear now,
The words come out in streams,
A pause where you expect it,
A line with no torn seams.
Nobody counts the breaths you take,
They only hear the flow.

[Hook - last time]
@voice bm_george
Take it in and let the line run long,
(run long!)
Leave a gap and let the beat come through,
Don't chop the word, just carry on,
(carry on!)
Say it once and let it move.
One breath, one phrase, room in the song,
One breath, one phrase, room in the song.
(break 2)

[Outro]
@voice af_heart
Take it in and let the line run on,
One breath, one phrase, room in the song.
